name: Maharashtra due-diligence screening pack
description: Evidence-based screening rules for Maharashtra property files. Findings are indicators for a reviewer, not legal determinations.

rules.title: No processed documents
rules.description: Upload and process property documents before due diligence.
evidence_required: At least one completed document extraction
rules.recommended_action: Upload at least the 7/12 extract and the latest transfer deed.

rules.title: 7/12 extract not found
rules.description: Maharashtra land due diligence typically requires a 7/12 extract (record of rights) for the latest position.

conditions.evidence: No document classified as 7/12 among the uploads

rules.recommended_action: Download the current 7/12 extract from Mahabhulekh and upload it.

rules.title: Survey/Gat number missing in property profile
rules.description: The property profile carries no survey, Gat or CTS number, so documents cannot be tied to a land record.
evidence_required: Survey, Gat or CTS number in the property profile
rules.recommended_action: Add the survey/Gat number from the 7/12 extract to the profile.

rules.title: Profile {field} differs from documents
rules.description: The identifier in the property profile does not match the value extracted from the uploaded documents.
evidence_required: Consistent survey/Gat/CTS number across the profile and every document
rules.recommended_action: Confirm which identifier is correct against the 7/12 extract and correct the profile or re-upload the document.

rules.title: Ownership chain has an unevidenced step
rules.description: At least one transfer in the ownership chain cannot be linked to an uploaded document; the missing instrument must be produced before the chain can be treated as continuous.
evidence_required: A registered instrument for every ownership step
rules.recommended_action: Request the missing predecessor deed/mutation from the seller and upload it to close the chain.

rules.title: Only an agreement to sale is available
rules.description: An agreement to sale does not by itself convey title; no registered transfer (sale/gift/partition/mutation) was found.
rules.recommended_action: Ask for the executed and registered sale deed that followed the agreement.

rules.title: No ownership evidence in the uploaded documents
rules.description: The uploads contain neither a transfer instrument nor a land record naming the holder, so no ownership chain could be built.
evidence_required: Transfer deed and/or current land record
rules.recommended_action: Upload a transfer deed and/or the current 7/12 extract or property card.

rules.title: Mortgage deed among the documents
rules.description: A mortgage creates a charge against the property; it must be cleared or consented to at transfer.
evidence_required: Encumbrance certificate and bank release/no-dues letter
rules.recommended_action: Verify the charge in the encumbrance certificate and obtain the bank's no-dues / release deed.

rules.title: Succession document requires verification
rules.description: A will or partition introduces succession-derived ownership; probate/partition formalities and all legal heirs must be verified.
evidence_required: Probate/partition deed and the legal-heir chain
rules.recommended_action: Obtain the probate/partition deed and confirm the legal-heir chain.

rules.title: Court document among the documents
rules.description: A filed document suggests pending or past proceedings touching the property; the current status must be checked.
evidence_required: Certified order and current court case status
rules.recommended_action: Search the court case status and obtain a certified copy of the order.

rules.title: Document area differs from the property profile
rules.description: At least one document deviates by more than 5% from the area recorded in the property profile.
evidence_required: Area stated in the 7/12 extract and the transfer deed
rules.recommended_action: Re-check the area against the 7/12 extract and re-measure if needed.

rules.title: Registered hash does not match the file
rules.description: One or more documents changed after their hash was recorded: the on-chain record and the file no longer agree.
evidence_required: SHA-256 fingerprint matching the registered on-chain record
rules.recommended_action: Re-obtain the document from the source; treat the changed file as untrusted.

rules.title: Survey number mismatch
rules.description: Extracted survey numbers differ across uploaded documents.
evidence_required: One consistent survey number across the document set
rules.recommended_action: Compare the survey number in each document and resolve the difference before relying on the set.

rules.title: Area discrepancy detected
rules.description: Document area values do not match.
evidence_required: One consistent area across the document set
rules.recommended_action: Compare the area in each document and resolve the difference before relying on the set.
